authority: PLANNER_BRIEF_2026-09-13.md Addendum 14 (E4: a few solves; local-solver noise floor sets eps_abs)

derivation_rule.delta_c: max over fixtures of max(RMS(W1-C1), RMS(W1-T1)) for channel c
derivation_rule.eps_abs: max(1e-5, 3 * max_c delta_c), rounded UP to the next value of the form 1eK or 3eK
derivation_rule.invalid_if: any replay does not terminate optimal or acceptable; W1 vs W2 not bitwise identical in the measured entries (report and stop - non-determinism must be understood first); fixture hash mismatch
derivation_rule.note: Addendum 14: tolerances are not loosened without derivation; this rule is the derivation. eps_abs stays 1e-5 unless the measured floor requires more. eps_rel unchanged at 1e-4.

fixtures.limitation: cycle-7 states, not terminal; one TSO block and one DSO block; the ESSO subproblem (tol 1e-10) is not measured
fixtures.note: exact PRE-SOLVE Pyomo models captured by production _save_frozen_network_block during the s32 gate (commit 9627525a; files hash-recorded in data/SRP1/Results/P515S32_run/evidence_manifest_sha256.json); current production formulation; cycle 7, warm-start path

measured_quantities.ESS: expected_shared_ess_p and _q entries times s_base divided by (2 * normalization rating), rating = _shared_ess_admm_normalization_mva(S, shared_ess_normalization_floor_mva) as in get_admm_boyd_residual_metrics
measured_quantities.PF: expected_interface_pf_p and _q entries times s_base divided by the interface rating (get_interface_branch_rating of the DSO network)
measured_quantities.V: expected_interface_vmag entries (TSO: [dn, p]; DSO: [p]) - already per-unit of v_base
measured_quantities.per_pair_statistics: for pairs (W1,W2), (W1,C1), (W1,T1): RMS per entry and max abs per entry of the difference, per channel; also termination status, iterations, objective difference

predictions: none on delta; the report states delta_c against the s32 per-entry steps above
purpose: Measure the iterate difference produced by the local NLP solver alone, at fixed inputs, in the Boyd normalized units of each channel, and derive eps_abs from it by a rule frozen here.
replay_method: fresh process state per replay: unpickle the fixture anew for EVERY solve (a solve mutates the model); context from p56a_oracle.fresh_planning; solver from production network._create_smopf_solver(net, model, params, from_warm_start=...), exactly as p512_y_tso_replay.py; load solutions into the model; no option changes except those listed per variant
stage: P5.15 Step 3.2 E4 - local-solver noise floor, frozen specification v1

variants_per_fixture.T1: warm with IPOPT tol and acceptable_tol each divided by 10 (tolerance sensitivity reference)
